card.name: Digits and links before inhaler drug names
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number, or a small linking word such as of, in, with or the, just before a combination inhaler or tablet drug name and its strength. It shows up in inhaler and cystic fibrosis drug labels.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a strength or rate, such as 100 or 125, right after a drug name.

modes.label: Linking word before a product name
modes.description: A short word such as of, in, with or the that comes just before a brand or drug name.

card.plain: It fires on a number or small linking word that comes just before the name of an inhaler or combination drug.
